sentence: Runs a four-option knockout bracket where the group votes on two first-round matches, then a final, to pick one pregame activity.
use_when: The group needs to pick one activity from four options
Someone asks to bracket or tournament-style vote on choices
A plain poll feels too loose and people want head-to-head picks
Choosing a pregame game or activity before an event
dont_use_when: There are more or fewer than four options to compare
The group wants a single quick poll with many options at once
People need to play an actual tournament with scores or results
